name: darkhorse-ingest
description: DarkHorse RAG ingestion pipeline — fetches SAP knowledge sources, chunks, embeds, and indexes them for retrieval by the darkhorse-mcp server.

scripts.rebuild: npm run clean && npm run build

notes.purpose: CPI-6 Sprint 2: RAG ingestion pipeline. Fetches SAP knowledge sources (SAP API Hub, Clean Core Extensibility Guide, SAP Architecture Center), chunks them, embeds them via a pluggable embedder, and writes them to a pluggable vector index.
notes.no-native-modules: Pure JS only. Uses Node 20's built-in fetch — no node-fetch dep.
notes.pluggable-backends: Embedder and VectorIndex are interfaces; Sprint 2 ships with in-memory mock backends. Real Azure OpenAI + Azure AI Search clients are swapped in a later session without touching the pipeline orchestration.
future-sprints: Sprint 2 session 2: PDF fetcher for SAP Clean Core Extensibility Guide
Sprint 2 session 3: Puppeteer fetcher for SAP Architecture Center (JS-rendered Docusaurus)
Sprint 2 session 4: refactor darkhorse-mcp tools to query the index with static-catalog fallback
Sprint 6: correction-store fetcher feeding developer edits back into the index
